inventory.method: Enumerated all states, dates and authors. Screened titles, descriptions and the paginated changed-file inventories of every PR. Read candidate patches including changed, deleted and added tests, gates, fixtures and eval harnesses. Scope distinguishes suite reviews, focused repairs, broader product PRs, prior-case corpus audits and integration.

matching_prs.title: test: add property-based invariant coverage
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Parser and routing invariants were exercised only by selected examples.
matching_prs.remedy: Added fast-check properties for route continuity, normalization, parser whitespace and chart containment across generated inputs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Generate bounded inputs for a stated invariant and retain focused examples for specific failures.

matching_prs.title: Increase agent doc example test timeout
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The Bun test's five-second deadline could expire while a legitimate example subprocess was still running.
matching_prs.remedy: Gave both documentation example tests 30-second outer budgets.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Coordinate the test deadline with the time taken by its child process.

matching_prs.title: Relax agent example subprocess timeout
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A documentation smoke test started the native PNG stack in a nested subprocess and timed out on slow CI machines after #16.
matching_prs.remedy: The example invocation now requests a lightweight placeholder for that smoke and uses a longer deadline. Dedicated tests still own real PNG generation.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep a smoke test focused on its promised behavior and test expensive integrations at a named boundary.

matching_prs.title: Structured mutation for all families, pie/quadrant, full-spectrum quality metrics
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: An independent audit found the ASCII core's existing tests did not distinguish some direction and nested-container cases.
matching_prs.remedy: Used scoped mutation runs to select regression cases and added deterministic pathfinder and nested/subgraph tests within a larger product PR.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Classify mutation survivors and add a behavioral witness for a real missing distinction.

matching_prs.title: Harden renderer tests with goldens and mutation configs
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Representative renderer fixtures missed unreachable routes, duplicate accessibility attributes and clipped relationship labels.
matching_prs.remedy: Expanded exact terminal fixtures, exercised unreachable and zero-boundary routes, and changed the XY accessibility test to reject duplicate root attributes.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Pair visible-output goldens with independent checks for the behavior they might accidentally approve.

matching_prs.title: Characterise the ASCII grid layout: contact sheet + PBT kernel
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Route correctness tests left ASCII grid behavior, renderer dispatch and observable output drift largely uncharacterized.
matching_prs.remedy: Extended routing properties and added a cross-family characterization corpus. Also pinned a specific equal-cost path ordering, a constraint later revisited in #428.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: State which observations are contractual before promoting characterization output to assertions.

matching_prs.title: Backfill diagram family citizenship gaps
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Family coverage carried known exceptions that allowed load-bearing terminal region identifiers to go unchecked.
matching_prs.remedy: Added per-family stable-region assertions and tightened the existing citizenship and corpus expectations.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: An enrolled family needs checks for the observable identifiers consumers use.

matching_prs.title: [codex] Add layout-complaint coverage and regression guards
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The layout complaints inventory identified untested edge vocabulary, edit stability, sequence overlap and Unicode display width.
matching_prs.remedy: Extended existing suites with edge/operator properties, sequence clearance and display-width examples. #69 later broadened the shared generators.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Connect a reported failure mode to its own exercised inputs and observable invariant.

matching_prs.title: Pin ELK degradation ladder fallback
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Broad crash-freedom stress tests could still pass if the ELK fallback ladder disappeared.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a three-node witness where tier zero throws and tier one succeeds. The public layout must return all three nodes and nine edges with finite coordinates.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Make the primary path demonstrably fail before claiming to exercise a fallback.

matching_prs.title: [codex] Fix decision branch label overlap
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Earlier SVG-structure checks could pass when rendered borders, endpoint/icon pixels or stroke styling were visually wrong.
matching_prs.remedy: Added raster-level checks for visible paint and nonblank rendered fixtures, alongside a decision-branch layout repair.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: When the claim is about visible marks, inspect raster or computed output at the affected region.

matching_prs.title: Close layout certificate gaps; add upstream parity ratchet
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The upstream parser corpus was a seed without an accounting of reviewed source blocks or of cases that never ran.
matching_prs.remedy: Created a harvest and ratchet with executable cases, explicit exclusions and separate Gantt ownership. #500/#508 later corrected the accounting and expectation generation.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep source provenance, executable cases and exclusions as separate counts.

matching_prs.title: [codex] Fix peer centering visual ratchets
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Valid routes could still put a peer trunk far from the visual center the layout intended.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a barycenter-delta metric and tests for nonterminal peer groups with several fan-in/fan-out sizes.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Measure the intended relationship directly instead of accepting generic layout validity.

matching_prs.title: Testing strategy: formalize oracle types and metamorphic relations
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A single visual check could not establish correctness. Hidden optional-data skips and shallow browser assertions further reduced coverage.
matching_prs.remedy: Added complementary structural round-trip, metamorphic and differential checks. Browser assertions were strengthened and optional data became explicit.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Name each oracle's blind spots and pair it with a check that fails for a different reason.

matching_prs.title: Issue-keyed regression fixtures for the 13 layout-aesthetic complaints
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Aggregate quality scores and issue mentions could hide one broken fixture. The old Gantt guard did not establish label/bar clearance.
matching_prs.remedy: Bound complaints to individual sources and asserted per-fixture route/label geometry, including long-range Gantt axis labels relative to actual bars.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Check each reported regression at the affected fixture before aggregating results.

matching_prs.title: Route mutation testing: survivor harvests + shard the nightly lane (keep bun:test)
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The broad route mutation lane timed out. Surviving geometry mutants showed the tests missed which dimension of a label blocked a route.
matching_prs.remedy: Proposed four shards and added targeted behavioral cases such as non-square label-pill clearance. Closed unmerged and superseded by #169.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Classify equivalent survivors separately and select fault probes that distinguish actual behavior.

matching_prs.title: test: lift five curated example tests to properties over generators
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Five suites inferred general invariants from a handful of curated inputs.
matching_prs.remedy: Added generated grouped services, parallel edges, multiline labels, sequence geometry and polyline simplification with endpoint/idempotence properties.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Choose a generator that reaches the asserted relationship and make the preconditions explicit.

matching_prs.title: Harden layout & parser test contracts from an audit (#37, #36, #41, #25)
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The geometric route properties saw only the solid arrow operator. The citizenship ratchet could also tolerate new exceptions.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a shared edge vocabulary, exercised distinct styles/markers in geometric properties and tightened exception accounting.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Inspect the vocabulary the generator actually feeds to each oracle.

matching_prs.title: Reify the layout pipeline as a pass manifest, with an equivalence gate, fuzzing, and route audits
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A label anywhere on its route passed, even if a fan-in label clung to an endpoint. Existing symmetry metrics missed some hub shapes.
matching_prs.remedy: Added generated corner cases and quality checks for the actual placement of labels/peer branches as part of a routing refactor.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Translate a visual complaint into the geometric property the old guard never measured.

matching_prs.title: Post-freeze repairs re-certify the edges they re-route; property seeds pinned (fixes #83)
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A route-certificate defect was found by chance on some CI rolls, with no stable witness in the normal suite.
matching_prs.remedy: Pinned the known failing seed and captured the minimized duplicate-edge source in a deterministic certificate-completeness test, alongside the runtime repair.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Preserve the exact counterexample and seed from a randomized failure.

matching_prs.title: Label-collision detection (eval/overlap-audit) and fixes across six families
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The corpus could pass with labels colliding across several existing diagram families because no check measured occlusion.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a final-SVG overlap audit, per-corpus gate and deterministic fuzz, then repaired collisions exposed by the new check.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: When fixtures already exhibit a defect, measure it on the emitted product.

matching_prs.title: Repo-wide fast-check seed policy: preload pin, AM_FC_SEED escape hatch, 1,368-run latent-failure sweep
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Individual suites reset the global fast-check configuration, so ordinary CI rolled unrecorded seeds in most files.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a repository preload with a default seed, explicit replay/random controls and save/restore around suite-specific pins.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Separate repeatable regression runs from exploratory seed sweeps and record how to replay both.

matching_prs.title: Make the agentic-mermaid npm package shippable, consistent, and fuzzed
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The previous source/development tests did not exercise the distributed artifact. Review also found an optional ASCII assertion and sampling that kept selecting one operation.
matching_prs.remedy: Exercised actual built and installed artifacts under Node, required the ASCII field unconditionally and changed operation sampling so multiple actions are reached.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Require the promised result to exist before comparing it, and sample inputs at the intended scope.

matching_prs.title: Make the homepage agent prompt a tested, measured onboarding surface
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The existing prompt evaluation could not tell whether guidance improved task correctness or whether answers relied on unaided discovery.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a no-docs comparison arm and knowledge cases whose graders reject plausible wrong answers.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Give an evaluation a comparison condition and test whether its grader distinguishes realistic failures.

matching_prs.title: Address PR #110 review: restore website:check gate, harden deploy, DOM-free lint
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Running tests rebuilt generated website inputs before the drift check, so stale committed output could pass.
matching_prs.remedy: Moved website:check ahead of test-triggered regeneration in CI and publication workflows.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Compare the original artifact before any setup step can repair it.

matching_prs.title: Add deterministic semantic facts for agent diagram checks
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Structural verification could accept a diagram with the wrong requested edit, including lost labels or a changed dependency.
matching_prs.remedy: Added deterministic typed facts and changed the agent-usage task grader to inspect expected state, visibility and dependency facts.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Score the requested semantic change independently of parse or render success.

matching_prs.title: Elevate the Journey family: shared parse core, experience curve, and a family-wide quality loop
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Five Journey regressions passed thousands of tests. Happy-path snapshots and four independent grammars missed overlapping bands and dropped tasks.
matching_prs.remedy: Added cross-surface parser-convergence tests and geometry checks for family and Journey layouts, including wide section labels.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: On a known escape, document which guard passed and add an independently measured invariant beside the snapshot.

matching_prs.title: Complete 14-family Mermaid 11.16 elevation with Style + Palette fidelity
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: An existing final-SVG overlap auditor skipped rotated text/rectangle geometry at non-right angles.
matching_prs.remedy: Extended the auditor to measure rotated corners while expanding real-content and deterministic generated cases.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Account for transforms in the observed coordinate space before certifying geometry.

matching_prs.title: Fix hosted MCP e2e error assertion
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A live E2E assertion still searched for a legacy flat error and rejected the current structured response.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed the smoke to require the public error code EXECUTE_FAILED and its message.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Assert the current error envelope and the correlated payload.

matching_prs.title: fix: enforce MCP and diagram safety contracts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Unit checks on already-parsed objects and helpers missed disagreement between transport serialization, actual clients and downstream consumers.
matching_prs.remedy: Added checks at real HTTP/stdio and package boundaries. The audit documents why a green helper test could miss a consumer-visible fault.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Place a walking-skeleton test where raw input enters and observe what its actual consumer receives.

matching_prs.title: Pie `highlightSlice`: fix off-centre slice displacement with research-backed non-geometric emphasis (Option D)
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Testing crisp SVG strings in isolation missed differences on styled renderers and did not exercise a real pointer or contrast on actual label ink.
matching_prs.remedy: Added emitted-paint, real-browser pointer and styled regression checks for the existing pie highlight behavior.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Follow the affected rendering backend and interaction to a visible observable.

matching_prs.title: test: retire broad nightly mutation infrastructure
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Broad scheduled mutation runs consumed CI without reliable completion, and line-number scopes drifted as code moved.
matching_prs.remedy: Removed the nightly workflow and broad acceptance floors, retaining bounded behavior-specific probes and opt-in diagnostics. This superseded #63.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Retire a quality proxy when its operational cost and fault-detection value no longer justify it.

matching_prs.title: Honor feedback link rank distance without packing regressions
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A long forward edge with a feedback edge present was counted as evidence about lengthening the feedback edge itself.
matching_prs.remedy: Added reciprocal/three-node cycles with the return edge lengthened across all directions, plus packing geometry checks.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Vary the exact operand or role named by the contract.

matching_prs.title: Harden post-merge Style, rendering, and agent contracts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Node/npm artifact checks could silently skip when their required tools were missing, so a green result could overstate what ran.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed installed-artifact tests to fail at setup if the tools are missing and pinned their environment in CI.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A missing dependency for a required gate is an infrastructure failure, not a passing or silently skipped test.

matching_prs.title: Fix Editor render parity across every site handoff
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A unit test copied editor option-merging logic. The browser test sampled three cards and shallow root tokens, allowing real editor handoffs to disagree.
matching_prs.remedy: Exercised actual Examples-to-Editor handoffs, comparing rendered results across cards and checking configuration after navigation.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Observe the consumer instead of reimplementing its transformation as the expectation.

matching_prs.title: Close repository consistency audit gaps
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The visual audit conflated ASCII and Unicode, missed render errors, treated option headers as diagram source and omitted real fixture families.
matching_prs.remedy: Separated output formats, enrolled actual sources and made render errors, warnings indicating failed ASCII, and empty output fail the audit.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Count failure and absence explicitly for each output format.

matching_prs.title: Align hosted PNG smoke payload with MCP schema
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The live PNG smoke sent style and seed in invalid request positions and misreported a healthy endpoint as broken.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed the shell request to its schema-defined shape and checked that the actual example includes required fields.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep a live probe's request within the public protocol it intends to test.

matching_prs.title: Verify MCP compatibility against all three reference client SDKs (TS, Python, Go)
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Testing server clauses alone did not establish compatibility with reference clients. Client success alone could also miss incorrect wire responses.
matching_prs.remedy: Exercised three SDKs and logged actual protocol exchanges, including the GET status that a tolerant client silently accepted.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Pair end-to-end success with the protocol observations the client may silently tolerate.

matching_prs.title: Gate the canonical degenerate-route corpus in CI
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Separate manual route checkers duplicated input generation, ran different populations and left the canonical CI suite unaware of failures.
matching_prs.remedy: Consolidated them into one 2,800-case runner, made errors and missing cases fail and enrolled it in CI/release checks.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Give a shared regression corpus a single enumerator, complete execution check and normal test entry point.

matching_prs.title: Replace Cartesian style tests with a complexity-aware portfolio
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A 4,500-render cartesian matrix held source complexity and output format constant, repeated 360 renders and did not prove its claimed interactions.
matching_prs.remedy: Replaced it with complexity strata and a variable-strength portfolio whose obligations are independently enumerated. Reused each reviewed golden cell once.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Measure covered interactions and fault sensitivity before dropping redundant combinations.

matching_prs.title: Make palette performance provenance squash-safe
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Evidence checks required an intermediate feature commit to stay reachable after squash merge, although the rendered inputs were identical.
matching_prs.remedy: Bound evidence to exact input hashes and tested the case in which the recording commit is no longer reachable.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use stable content identity for evidence that must survive a squash merge.

matching_prs.title: Make contact-sheet review advisory for releases
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The publication gate required structured duration and row-review records beyond the human review actually performed.
matching_prs.remedy: Removed the mandatory workflow step while retaining optional contact-sheet generation and review records.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Separate human review from an automated pass condition whose records do not demonstrate the judgment.

matching_prs.title: Subtract redundant product surfaces
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Twenty mutation scripts/configs and full-history reconstruction duplicated maintenance for existing evidence.
matching_prs.remedy: Consolidated mutation configurations into named profiles and removed routine full-history reconstruction from testing.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Collapse repeated diagnostic configurations around a maintained owner.

matching_prs.title: Harden website build and cache authorities
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The test preload could silently reuse a stale built website or stamp a build as fresh even as inputs changed.
matching_prs.remedy: Fingerprinted transitive build inputs, checked the build's input snapshot and added explicit stale-input controls.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A reused fixture must be traceable to all inputs of the build that produced it.

matching_prs.title: Unify quality gates and narrow evidence provenance
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The evidence gate hashed unrelated development dependencies, stopped after one stale receipt and had no single local equivalent of CI.
matching_prs.remedy: Scoped receipt dependencies to the runtime graph and used one quality command to collect and report failures together.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Bind evidence to the inputs that can change its outcome.

matching_prs.title: Serve MCP 2025-11-25 and the 2026-07-28 stateless era, with the test and CI work it exposed
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The golden-change checker reasoned from the head commit's approval token instead of the actual set of commits changing files.
matching_prs.remedy: Updated its data model and tests to attribute each changed golden to its own commit and to reject irrelevant token occurrences. #370 later removed the token rule.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: If a historical gate exists, validate each covered change against its own evidence.

matching_prs.title: Fix hosted PNG verifier bootstrap
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A standalone PNG verifier relied on prior imports to register renderers. A shared test process could hide the missing initialization.
matching_prs.remedy: Initialized the registry in the verifier and added a fresh-process test that passes a valid PNG response to it.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Run command-line verifier tests in a fresh process when test-order state can affect startup.

matching_prs.title: fix: parse MCP deployment probe results
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A production smoke searched raw JSON-RPC bytes for a field nested inside a serialized text result, rejecting healthy responses.
matching_prs.remedy: Decoded the envelope and exactly one JSON text result before checking the typed verify/execute values.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Decode each wire layer before asserting its payload.

matching_prs.title: Harden MCP scope and conformance
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The existing MCP evaluation lacked independent conformance, negative inputs, family-balanced reporting and full provenance.
matching_prs.remedy: Added protocol-input negatives and an executable conformance lane and expanded the eval inventory. #239 later found inventory alone insufficient.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Pair supported-input checks with refusal behavior, independent conformance and a measured population.

matching_prs.title: Make skill eval evidence executable
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A manifest was being counted as completed evaluation. Hidden task stubs leaked answers, paths resolved from the wrong checkout and the docs corpus overrepresented flowcharts.
matching_prs.remedy: Bound inputs, outputs and grader to the selected checkout, added known-bad grader controls and required a complete per-task run matrix.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Distinguish a declared case from an executed, independently graded result.

matching_prs.title: test: harden hosted skill eval evidence
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: An aggregate zero exit and a self-declared runner version could certify an evaluation where every task failed or where another runner executed.
matching_prs.remedy: Required per-task metrics, traces, completed messages and materialized outputs. Verified the installed runner and added ablations.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Never derive an evaluation pass from process exit alone. Validate the expected task population and artifacts.

matching_prs.title: test: derive hosted protocol versions in deploy probe
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Hard-coded protocol lists made the hosted deployment smoke require a revision that the hosted transport did not serve.
matching_prs.remedy: Took the expected hosted revisions from the protocol authority and checked unsupported-version responses preserve the request ID.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Bind each transport's expected capabilities to its published contract and validate request correlation.

matching_prs.title: test: gate deploys on production site smoke
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A candidate could pass the hosted MCP verifier while its independently served website, discovery resources or editor assets were broken.
matching_prs.remedy: Added semantic website probes on the immutable candidate and again after promotion.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Check each delivered surface via its own production-facing entry point.

matching_prs.title: fix: tolerate static cache during promotion
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The post-promotion website smoke demanded the new SHA immediately from eventually consistent static caches, falsely rolling back a healthy deployment.
matching_prs.remedy: Kept exact SHA on the immutable candidate and MCP attestation while checking route health at the public website after promotion.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Assert identity at the immutable target and choose a post-promotion check consistent with cache semantics.

matching_prs.title: Fix the v0.4.1 package manifest gate
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: CI exercised consumer tarballs but omitted the package-file-set comparison used at release, so drift appeared only on the publication path.
matching_prs.remedy: Enrolled the existing verifier with the release toolchain in the canonical checked build and refreshed the inventory.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Exercise a release-critical verifier before the release event on the same artifact and tooling.

matching_prs.title: Preserve approved security-release evidence pixels
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Refreshing input provenance regenerated previously approved pictures even when the release made no visual change.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a tested receipt-only refresh and restored the reviewed image bytes.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Do not rewrite expected outputs as a side effect of updating provenance.

matching_prs.title: Revert repository-enforced Mermaid intent survey
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A continuous issue survey, hand-scored familiarity rubric and structural synchronization tests imposed maintenance without testing rendered behavior.
matching_prs.remedy: Removed the survey/scoring gates and their structural tests, preserving focused construct-level work.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Delete mechanically synchronized scores when observable product contracts supply better evidence.

matching_prs.title: Preserve whitespace through shrinkable flowchart mutations
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The mutation property permitted operations to fail and only required the final diagram to parse. Wrong labels and missing edges could pass.
matching_prs.remedy: Replaced the operation array with fast-check commands, preconditions, and an independent shadow model checked after each operation. The PR reports finding trimmed label whitespace.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: For stateful APIs, model the intended state transition and compare after every successful operation.

matching_prs.title: Correct agent-usage eval coverage and failure attribution
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The evaluator counted formatting and capture errors as semantic failures, and only two of sixteen families had both a create and edit case.
matching_prs.remedy: Separated capture integrity, semantic task result and response format. Expanded the standard family population and reclassified historical transcripts by cause.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Report infrastructure, presentation and task correctness separately and disclose the eligible denominator.

matching_prs.title: test: add construct fidelity receipt foundation
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Family-level capability reports could not show that an individual language construct survived parsing, rendering, serialization and editing.
matching_prs.remedy: Added version-pinned construct cases and explicit per-surface semantic oracles and nonapplicability decisions.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Ground an advertised capability in representative executed behavior at each applicable public surface.

matching_prs.title: test: adopt landed behavior into fidelity receipts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Existing family tests did not distinguish a supported parse from unsupported paint or other downstream gaps in the public coverage projection.
matching_prs.remedy: Added per-surface cases for already-landed Sankey, XYChart and Flowchart behavior, keeping known rendering divergence explicit.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: When adopting historical test evidence, distinguish the surface it proves and the ones it leaves open.

matching_prs.title: Make diagrams truthful, complete and readable in every family and style
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Green application verification and snapshots admitted unreadable text, off-canvas titles and charts whose bar heights misstated values.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a raster oracle for actual ink and visibility, plus generated chart-honesty properties and targeted model/paint checks.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Test the physical quantity or readability guarantee the chart communicates, separately from successful rendering.

matching_prs.title: Replace the freshness alarm with a one-time release to-do; check hosted render_ascii against the library on the default path
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The default hosted terminal path could return an incorrect drawing and still satisfy a corner-character assertion.
matching_prs.remedy: The changed hosted test compares both complete default charsets against the library. The PR incorporates #375's implementation through a merge commit.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A parity smoke should compare the consumer's complete result for the real default path.

matching_prs.title: Prove typed SVG route equivalence across built-in families
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Adapter conformance covered only one native and two diagnosed sample cases.
matching_prs.remedy: Ran existing family inputs and two distinct option sets through in-process adapters, comparing complete SVG and receipts and typed refusals.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Exercise every enrolled adapter/family combination promised by the assertion and state the remaining transport boundary.

matching_prs.title: Review eight pinned XY Chart official fences with semantic receipts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: XY Chart examples: eight source examples could parse while values, labels, legends or plotted geometry were wrong.

matching_prs.title: Revert the official fence receipts that pin pre-#281 rendering
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Eleven official-example receipt changes pinned implementation colors, halos or whole SVG digests, repeatedly blocking an intentional rendering change.
matching_prs.remedy: Reverted those receipts while retaining the unaffected Journey receipt. The stated intent was to reconsider/reland them against the new rendering.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Review the actual semantic obligation before re-recording many implementation-sensitive digests.

matching_prs.title: Simplify verification: check behaviour, not implementation
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Source fragments, output and input hashes, byte baselines and committed screenshots failed after behavior-neutral changes. The PR reports 13 failures from adding one comment.
matching_prs.remedy: Replaced input-hash receipts with current-render checks, tested real editor interactions, and added model, differential and metamorphic properties.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Try a harmless refactor and a real faulty result. A valuable behavior check accepts the former and rejects the latter.

matching_prs.title: Make the docs agree with each other and with the code, and keep them that way
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Token-presence checks allowed maintained documentation to contradict code or other docs while all expected words were present.
matching_prs.remedy: Generated facts from their owning registries and checked executable CLI examples/enumerations instead of copied token lists.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Test the usable command or precise documented fact at the surface readers receive.

matching_prs.title: Match upstream Mermaid on the defects the property tests found, and close two doc-check gaps
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Properties pinned known parser defects as observations. Documentation checks also missed broken references and stale enumerations.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed known-defect assertions to require the fixed behavior and added owning reference checks.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Once a bug is repaired, replace its characterization with a regression assertion that requires the intended semantics.

matching_prs.title: CI follow-ups to #331: job timeouts, package lint, one lazy-budget check, expiring label approvals
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Package lint checked only filenames and the lazy budget was checked twice. A completed shard could hang until the six-hour default.
matching_prs.remedy: Added packed-package verification, assigned the lazy budget to one post-build check and bounded jobs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Inspect the delivered package and give each costly gate a single execution point.

matching_prs.title: Tests protect behaviour: remove tests of tests, mutation testing and committed derived files
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Trace tests passed when their scripts failed to parse. A hexagon check observed an arrowhead in definitions. Tests also checked other tests, requiring repeated regeneration.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed trace/shape assertions to observe the right output, deleted 55 test files per the PR, retired mutation/sabotage infrastructure and replaced 375 styled hashes with 16 readable SVG goldens.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Make a test reach its named subject, eliminate checks whose subject is another check and retain reviewable output where it is valuable.

matching_prs.title: Converge five family parsers and strengthen meaning-preservation tests
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Separate parser properties could agree with their own projections while losing State, Radar or Sankey meaning across parse/export.
matching_prs.remedy: Generated independent expected models for State and Radar and asserted public Sankey preservation and refusal. The PR separately reports 60 assertion failures against base.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Have the generator retain expected values from construction, independent of the parser being tested.

matching_prs.title: Replace golden approval token with PR review
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A commit-message approval token gated changed goldens without supplying semantic review and also rejected uncommitted changes.
matching_prs.remedy: Deleted the token checker and used PR review of each changed golden and its reason.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Move subjective baseline approval to a reviewable diff with an explanation of the intended change.

matching_prs.title: Test audit: hosted render_ascii default-path parity; corpus render-hash removal as a patch (after #374)
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Checking just a box-drawing or plus character let incorrect hosted ASCII output through. Separate corpus hashes pinned the renderer's own layout.
matching_prs.remedy: Diff changes only the default hosted parity check to compare both charsets with the library. Corpus hash deletion was a proposed patch in the PR body. The test change was folded into #335.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Distinguish transported output parity from validity of the renderer, and proposed deletions from actual diff changes.

matching_prs.title: Keep XY-chart titles inside the canvas and report hidden titles
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The title generator used single-line inputs and normalized observed text to lowercase, hiding clipped multiline titles and changed capitalization.
matching_prs.remedy: Retained a minimized multiline caller input and exact-case/paint evidence in owning chart tests. Closed unmerged, with the PR identifying equivalent fixes in #395.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use a reduced witness for a limitation deliberately outside a normalized oracle's scope.

matching_prs.title: Finish Python MCP evidence and source-backed comparison corrections
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The Python interoperability probe used a deprecated SDK client, stale copied version expectations and indistinguishable evidence for an absent versus refused GET.
matching_prs.remedy: Updated the SDK probe to observe actual HTTP requests/responses and negotiated headers on successful calls.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Separate an observed refusal from a request that never happened.

matching_prs.title: Pin Mermaid 12.2.0 and align compatibility contracts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Current reference tests and policy named different Mermaid revisions, leaving the meaning of conformance results ambiguous.
matching_prs.remedy: Aligned the active reference helper and tests to a single revision, while preserving original provenance for historical imported corpora.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Pin the independent reference actually executed and keep historical fixture versions separate.

matching_prs.title: Make release benchmarks measure published bytes and comparable work
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The release benchmark tested a separate build, retained correctness only from the first process and allowed zero rounds or incomparable memory populations.
matching_prs.remedy: Benchmarked the verified packed artifact, checked outputs every process/repetition, matched workloads across arms and rejected empty observations.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A benchmark gate needs a nonempty comparable population and proof that it exercised the artifact being released.

matching_prs.title: Test all supported diagram types and fix C4 label overlaps
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: An independent compatibility check could be skipped without blocking release, and package tests did not cover all supported diagram types.
matching_prs.remedy: Required the independent compatibility gate and exercised installed SVG/terminal output for all 17 supported families.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Treat a missing required verification distinctly from a passing result.

matching_prs.title: Repair shared outline contrast and verify emitted ink across families
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Token-level contrast checks alone did not establish that a visible outline had sufficient contrast against its painted background.
matching_prs.remedy: Extended existing contrast suites with owned SVG stroke-versus-background checks and actual PNG border-only sampling.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Observe the mark and background after style application and bound the claim to the sampled colors/inputs.

matching_prs.title: Improve release benchmark gates and add browser competitor scorecards
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The release performance gate could pass with missing baseline timing, missing memory observations or incomplete candidate workloads.
matching_prs.remedy: Made expected comparative measurements and successful candidate scaling/agent workloads mandatory and added negative cases.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Define the complete expected population before collecting benchmark data.

matching_prs.title: Add 0.5 measurement tooling: micro, peer and output-identity benchmarks, fork graph, Mermaid reference setup
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: An output-identity run with more jobs than inputs could compare/copy partial digests. Typed-parser cases could accept opaque fallback results.
matching_prs.remedy: Required every digest on each side, compared the union of keys and guarded typed cases. The faults were found while reviewing the PR's measurement tooling.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Prove both sides produced the complete expected key set before comparing outputs.

matching_prs.title: Replace implementation locks with behavioral test contracts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Tests pinned source spellings, pipeline order, serializer call counts, spacing constants and one arbitrary shortest-path tie break.
matching_prs.remedy: Exercised browser storage failure and emitted MCP errors, checked shortest repeatable routes/painted clearance and strengthened independent semantic checks beside existing goldens.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Permit equivalent valid implementations and check visible guarantees. Preserve implementation constraints only when they are explicit product requirements.

matching_prs.title: Strengthen fast-check testing with Hegel guidance
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Suite-local seeds/run counts defeated exploratory configuration, some generators/substring checks excluded valid output, and aggregated samples could not shrink.
matching_prs.remedy: Centralized strong/replayable runner settings and replaced oracles with independent XML parsing, exact Sankey values and shrinkable properties. The PR reports finding malformed Radar SVG.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep regression seeds replayable while letting discovery vary. Use an independent parser or expected state to check generated outputs.

matching_prs.title: Make rendering dependencies and evidence conditional; retain feasible layouts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A copied package-export inventory could fail after a valid refactor while existing package checks already covered the delivered contract.
matching_prs.remedy: Deleted the redundant export-key expectation from the package suite during a larger rendering change.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Before removing a duplicated inventory, identify the tests that exercise actual package resolution and behavior.

matching_prs.title: Keep test workers responsive when Bun children hang
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A synchronous subprocess blocked the worker event loop, so the test deadline could not interrupt a hang and the entire CI shard stalled.
matching_prs.remedy: Converted 25 synchronous sites to the existing asynchronous owned-child helper, added explicit deadlines and process-group cleanup.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Give the supervisor an opportunity to time out and reap owned subprocesses.

matching_prs.title: test: run Getting Started commands against the packed package
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Website tests inspected Getting Started command text without running it. The published instructions referenced a file the reader had never created.
matching_prs.remedy: Executed documented shell blocks in fresh consumers using the packed package and checked actual SVG, PNG, terminal, JSON and MCP outputs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Run a copied example in the environment and state a new reader would actually have.

matching_prs.title: Fix nightly finder regressions and deduplicate reports
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Nightly properties generated invalid reserved names, assumed unquantized bar geometry, or sampled antialiased text incorrectly. Repeat findings created duplicate notifications.
matching_prs.remedy: Corrected domains and observations, retained the reduced inputs and deduplicated notifications while preserving each run's evidence.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Determine whether a failed property reflects bad input, a bad oracle or a product defect before changing production.

matching_prs.title: bench: calibrate complete semantic populations and remove consumer allocation noise
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A measurement consumer allocated memory while reading output and could attribute its own cost to the renderer. Some peer comparisons lacked complete semantic populations.
matching_prs.remedy: Indexed consumed bytes directly, retained complete comparable populations and separated consumer allocation from renderer evidence.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Measure observer overhead and bind performance comparisons to matching, qualified outputs.

matching_prs.title: Fix release checks for symlinked npm installs and macOS
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Release validation rejected identical packages installed through a symlink and invoked checksum flags unavailable on macOS.
matching_prs.remedy: Checked actual package/lock identity from physical paths and added platform-specific release checks.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Normalize equivalent platform paths without dropping artifact identity checks.

matching_prs.title: Execute pinned Mermaid assertions through native model adapters
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A source-acceptance count was used where the question was whether upstream assertions actually pass against the native model.
matching_prs.remedy: Executed original pinned test bodies through a pinned control and native model adapters, retaining original parameterization and expectations.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Do not equate parsing an upstream source with passing that upstream test's assertions.

matching_prs.title: Preserve Mermaid grammar fields and identities through typed edits
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Tar archive creation ran synchronously outside the test fixture's child deadline, so a stalled tool could leave a worker stuck.
matching_prs.remedy: Moved all archive creation through the existing owned child boundary, awaited completion and checked status before reading bytes.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A timeout must govern the process doing the work; require success before consuming its artifact.

matching_prs.title: Run endpoint audit regressions in the standard test suite
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A valid endpoint-marker regression suite existed outside the directories selected by normal CI.
matching_prs.remedy: Updated the package's canonical test command to enroll the existing suite.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Confirm the intended regression is discovered by the normal entry point.

matching_prs.title: Strengthen test oracles and remove low-value test ceremony
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Assertions accepted empty or stale artifacts, derived expected values from production, compared unrelated values or asserted private implementation; duplicated smoke and source-grep tests added ceremony.
matching_prs.remedy: Across 215 changed files, strengthened visible terminal connectivity, PNG dimensions, computed browser paint and task grading and removed duplicate and implementation-only tests. The PR describes reviewing 573 authored files.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: For each test identify its consumer and failure witness, independently derive the expected result, then consolidate or remove overlap with an existing owner.

matching_prs.title: Extract historical Mermaid cases from complete bound source arguments
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A historical test harvester counted strings resembling test calls as registrations, admitted incomplete dynamic source and treated extraction gaps as unsupported product cases.
matching_prs.remedy: Switched to TypeScript AST registration/binding analysis and complete source arguments with explicit unresolved outcomes.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Count actual executed registrations and classify extraction failures separately from product failures.

matching_prs.title: Construct portable tokens and preserve empty grammar fields
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A control treated the reference parser's acceptance of a word prefix as proof it preserved the complete State class target.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed the existing State test to distinguish accepted prefixes from the complete target and preserve unsupported source atomically.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Validate the full expected field and ownership; acceptance alone does not prove retention.

matching_prs.title: Reconcile historical harvest sources and accounting units
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The harvester mixed fixture and registration counts, conflated extraction with product gaps and generated expected geometry from the implementation under test.
matching_prs.remedy: Replaced the expectation-writing path with read-only provenance reporting and explicit source-recovery outcomes. Existing assertions and floors were left in place. Integrated via #516.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep independently reviewed expectations separate from observation or harvesting tools.

matching_prs.title: Preserve diagram meaning and make historical harvesting read-only
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A historical harvester could write current renderer output as expectations and represented unrelated accounting units as upstream coverage.
matching_prs.remedy: Integrated the #508 and #506 component work, including read-only provenance extraction and explicit Model/writer controls. This landing overlaps those component PRs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep component review and integration evidence traceable without counting them as separate discoveries.

matching_prs.title: Land the Trident extraction cleanup and benchmark harness fixes
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: The benchmark harness mixed reference installations/versions, permitted missing label data and had false failures caused by temporary-path aliases.
matching_prs.remedy: Pinned the actual independent oracle, checked controls before timing, refused incomplete observations and normalized test temp paths.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Validate the independent reference and the observable sample before accepting timing or coverage results.

matching_prs.title: Deduplicate contracts and split editor, routing, and site modules
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A research sketch prototype served as a proxy for contrast in shipped renderers, and hand-built editor script fixtures could differ from actual module code.
matching_prs.remedy: Moved contrast coverage to shipped rough/hybrid renderers and changed tests to consume editor modules through the maintained harness.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Exercise the shipped implementation or final artifact for claims about the shipped product.

matching_prs.title: Resolve the Trident launcher test's temporary path on macOS
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A launcher test compared a symlinked macOS temporary path to the child's physical path and failed only on macOS.
matching_prs.remedy: Normalized the test fixture using realpathSync before asserting forwarded directories.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Normalize path identity at the fixture boundary when both spellings represent the same directory.

matching_prs.title: Remove the legacy eval/benchmark copy now that Trident runs every benchmark
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Two maintained copies of the benchmark suite and its tests risked divergent behavior after benchmark ownership moved to Trident.
matching_prs.remedy: Removed the legacy local copies, including the duplicate portable/benchmark suites, and pinned the replacement runner.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: After moving a test suite, retire duplicate ownership and make the replacement entry point explicit.

matching_prs.title: Finish moving benchmark ownership to Trident
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Community-discovery and modern-evidence checks still duplicated benchmark ownership already in Trident.
matching_prs.remedy: Deleted remaining copied evidence tests, keeping product regression tests and the independent Mermaid oracle separate.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Retain the consumer's product obligations while deleting copies of an external tool's own tests.

matching_prs.title: Give grammar finder reports finite scope and replay reviewed findings
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: An ever-open issue and its comments stored the grammar finder's deduplication state. Exploratory disagreements were mixed with demonstrated export/round-trip defects.
matching_prs.remedy: Retained reviewed sources as a versioned regression corpus and separated actionable failures from exploratory findings.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Store replayable evidence and a finite, explicit classification for discovery results.

matching_prs.title: Retain curved-node Flowchart regression after routing fix
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A minimized nightly counterexample had no durable place in the public routing property. Helper-specific tests for a superseded workaround added little evidence.
matching_prs.remedy: Added the actual source as an explicit example in the existing structural property. The final diff retains the public counterexample and does not ship the earlier workaround.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Retain the smallest public regression when removing scaffolding for an obsolete implementation.

matching_prs.title: test(mcp): align hosted syntax probe with Code Mode screening
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A hosted smoke asserted a JavaScript engine's wording even though public syntax screening now rejects the request earlier.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed the shell assertion to verify correlated JSON-RPC response fields, the tool error flag and the structured screening error.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Assert the public error boundary and its envelope, not private runtime phrasing.

matching_prs.title: Retain source benchmark replay controls in receipts
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A source benchmark documented explicit seed overrides but omitted the effective default seed passed to its actual test child.
matching_prs.remedy: Recorded resolved seed/run counts after applying overrides and extended the child-process test to cover the default and explicit controls.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Record the effective settings the worker received when reporting a replayable test result.

matching_prs.title: fix: align ELK route roundoff where each adapter reads routes back
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A new wide-tree regression briefly required an overall certification status unrelated to the specific card-contact bug.
matching_prs.remedy: The final patch checks that public layout succeeds and all 79 directed relationships survive; the PR records why it removed the unrelated status claim during review.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Require the contract at issue and let separately owned certification checks judge unrelated geometry.

matching_prs.title: Reduce repeated CI work and make test failures trustworthy
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Recipe checks could pass following crashes or reuse an earlier PNG. JSON-RPC and batch checks could succeed without observing the right correlated result.
matching_prs.remedy: Required usable recipe output and fresh files, checked exact IDs and successful work after malformed batch entries, and retired redundant goldens/CI checks such as hero freshness.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Require fresh outputs attributable to this invocation, fail on errors and prove the next valid operation still works.

matching_prs.title: Fix verification gaps and upgrade CI to Bun 1.4.4
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Website tests reused stale prepared output, an SVG comparer accepted visibly shifted dashes, and its fault checks were repeated per diagram.
matching_prs.remedy: Prepared the website explicitly per run and made a real Chromium comparer check painted stroke coverage in both directions. Consolidated repeated verifier work.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use fresh build inputs and the visible effect for image equivalence, with positive and negative controls.

matching_prs.title: Compare visual goldens by decoded pixels
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: Visual regression tests rejected a re-encoded PNG with identical pixels because they compared encoded file bytes.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed the two suites to compare dimensions and decoded RGBA against reviewed goldens. The PR reports accepting re-encoding and detecting a one-pixel change. Open at review time.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Choose the equivalence relation that matches the user-visible contract and test both sides of it.

matching_prs.title: Fix agent-experience findings from the axis.run assessment, merged with main
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: A validator property only asserted that values considered clean could render. It skipped rejected inputs and did not establish the reverse implication or terminal parity.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed the property to test acceptance and rejection over both SVG and terminal entry points, and required observations of both branches.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: For an acceptance contract, generate both admitted and refused cases and verify each branch was exercised.

matching_prs.title: Improve route traceability and graph layout selection
matching_prs.author: adewale
matching_prs.weakness: An invisible-edge point-count assertion pinned an internal route representation that could change without changing any visible obligation.
matching_prs.remedy: Replaced the point-count comparison with checks on visible hard findings, crossing count and label conflicts in a broader routing PR. Open at review time.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: For invisible constraints, inspect the effect on visible relationships and quality instead of an arbitrary internal count.

exclusions: Feature regression tests alone, routine golden refreshes, test updates required only by a removed product feature, runner rebalance alone and benchmark/tool pins alone were excluded. Examples include #622 (editor regression), #616 (retired backend), #598 (runner reassignment), #507 (provisioning) and #518 (pin only).

The 13 official-example PRs #341–#353 are a linked corpus re-audit of existing smoke/coverage claims. They do not represent 13 distinct test-audit methods. #354 subsequently removed eleven receipt changes. #343 was kept. #353 was closed unmerged.

#63 is a closed, unmerged proposal superseded by #169. The parity change from closed-unmerged #375 was folded into #335; the render-hash deletion in #375's body was not included in its diff. #516 integrates #506 and #508. Count PRs and workstreams separately.

Focused bug fixes are included when they also changed a preexisting ineffective test, tested a documented omission in the existing strategy, or repaired a verifier. Numerous ordinary bug-fix cases with only newly added feature-specific regression tests were excluded.
limitations: PR metadata and diff content were reviewed. Tests, fault injections, historical CI, and reported numeric outcomes were not rerun independently. GitHub merged_at determines merge status; component landings and proposed-only changes are called out where visible.

This is an evidence-based classification. File lists include renamed, generated and binary files; GitHub can omit large/binary patch bodies. The counts apply to the returned repository history on the review date.
